decisions.rationale: A synchronous lane-controller call blocks the only request loop, so the active P1 worker cannot use the candidate broker and two P3 lane calls cannot progress. The fix is a bounded controller subprocess/monitor plus a narrow non-capability worker request channel, not a scheduler.
The facade lacks exact C1/delegated/UTC admission and claims replay only after dispatch. Admission must be create-once before side effects for both serve and one-shot paths.

In-memory live state, idle exit, retained terminal controllers, and missing terminal evidence cannot establish candidate-owned quiescence. A small durable registry/status/heartbeat and signed drain-to-terminal shutdown are necessary.

The existing strict broker correctly requires causal candidate-dispatch evidence, but the facade cannot create it. A narrow substitute-assignment/launch/result adapter around the same target-worker path is required; weakening the broker is forbidden.

A1 must be Terra-medium priority with test_writer gate, P1 Luna-high default with test_executor gate, R1 Terra-medium priority with reviewer gate, and C1 Terra-medium default without a gate. The exact user model/topology contract is testable and low-risk to correct.

root_additional_required_closure: Each assignment uses a candidate-created isolated target Git worktree/branch based on the latest accepted target commit; O can accept a completed current-tip branch only through a signed candidate operation, and the candidate revalidates immutable seed content.
The candidate, not O, generates every worktree path, branch, invocation, safe worker-channel path, role/model/tier/gate, and candidate-controlled prompt prefix. O supplies task content only.
Per-lane physical executions may run concurrently only in separate candidate-owned lane tasks under the one active P1 assignment; calls for the same lane remain serialized.
Readiness validates and hash-binds exact C1/delegated/seed/policy/templates/manifest/topology inputs before any request, and the service cannot terminate by idle timeout.
rerun_policy: Repair production only, join the existing focused test commit, and rerun only the dependency-invalidated C3 control-plane IDs. No prior green registry ID, protected suite, MCP, or hardware test is authorized.
